fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-e07461be at b0c7d417: ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogStalled -v: PASS. The test uses a fixed clock (t0 plus offsets), a temp session store with fake hook reports and fake send/stop/resume/log deps. Autonomous run A: no action at 19m, nudged at 21m (first limit, agentNudge 20m), stopped and resumed once at 41m (second limit, agentRetry 40m) with exactly one 'stopped and resumed' log line and Spent=1; at 90m, with retryBudget 1 spent, it is held instead of retried. Run B reported progress at 30m, so it was left alone at 41m. Owner-attended run O was never stopped or resumed, got a log line and a hold, and the hold became an InboxStalled item. Read the diff: watchdogStalled/daemonWatchdog in internal/api/daemon_watchdog.go, wired into the poll in place of daemonNudge when watchdog.enabled; memory and holds persisted in daemon.State and carried across restarts; holds surfaced in inbox and notify; session.Stallable split out of Stalled with the same behaviour; run.Terminate sends SIGTERM. Also passed: TestWatchdogPolicy and the internal/session, run and daemon packages; go vet is clean. All tests in the wider api subset (Nudge|Inbox|Daemon|Stall) passed, but the package's root-state guard then flagged ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live root daemon on the VM writes during a 575s run. That is not touched by this diff.
